what: Federal Realty owns open-air shopping centres and mixed-use districts in wealthy suburbs of Washington, Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Los Angeles and Miami, many of them with flats above the shops.
customers: Supermarkets, restaurants, services and speciality retailers leasing space, plus residential tenants.
moat: A small portfolio of irreplaceable locations: its centres sit in the densest, highest-income suburbs in America, where nothing new can be built.
risks: Mixed-use redevelopment ties up capital for years before it earns anything
22 times earnings for a landlord growing rents in the low single digits
opportunities: A 32.1% net margin and the longest record of consecutive dividend increases of any REIT, nearly sixty years
Revenue grew from $951M to $1.3B in four years
Analysts see about 15% upside, and occupancy is near record levels
watch: Leased occupancy and the rent spread on renewals.
